Mortality, Premature to body mass index: 7 findings (hazard ratio ≈ 2.10 — they rise together) [1]; body mass index to smoking: 27 findings (regression slope ≈ 0.87 — they rise together) [5]; smoking to poverty: 10 findings (odds ratio ≈ 1.22 — they rise together) [9]. City-side, the measures rise and fall together across the 42 health districts (ρ +0.88). Each step is thin, and thin steps compound — but the chain exists, which the direct edge cannot say. A chain is a hypothesis: it tells you which study to run next.

bridges.cap: No study directly links Mortality, Premature to poverty. 34 concepts bridge them in one step. 303 chains connect them in two steps — top 25 shown. Across 42 city health districts the measures rise and fall together (ρ=+0.88).

bridges.cap: No study directly links poverty to air conditioning. 7 concepts bridge them in one step. 193 chains connect them in two steps — top 25 shown. Across 42 city health districts the measures move in opposite directions (ρ=-0.86).

mediated.note: Curated flagship — the original pattern. Direct link: 0 SPG associations, city ρ=0.02. Hop 1 is carried by NYC (vegetation cover cools surfaces); hop 2 is the physical mechanism (hot surfaces → heat exposure), assumed, not separately evidenced in either dataset here; hops 3-4 are documented SPG edges (heat → hospitalization → emergency department).

cards.b: SPG holds 0 associations between green-space and emergency-care concepts. The naive city check agrees (ρ≈0.02 cover→heat ED) — but vegetation cover clearly depresses surface temperature (ρ=−0.396), and the graph itself supplies 70 heat×emergency-care associations. The chain cover → cooler surfaces → fewer heat outcomes is supported piecewise by the two datasets together; the direct edge is untested in the literature — the research target.

Street-tree census is 2015; vegetation cover 2010–2017; surface temperature a single day (2018); heat outcomes 2000–2022; 311 complaints 2024–2026. Cross-dataset claims must state which years each leg rests on — every concept-map row carries year ranges.

EHDP 'burden' measures (PM2.5 asthma ED visits, deaths from PM2.5/ozone, heat vulnerability index) are modeled attributions, not observations. City checks that use them reproduce the model, not the city — flagged ρ⚠ in the confirmations table.
The same EHDP indicator appears as Number, Percent, rate and age-adjusted rate; SPG associations mix OR/RR/r with 89% null study_type. Compare directions only, never magnitudes across that boundary.

'Heat ED visits' counts heat-stress visits during warm months (ICD-coded); SPG heat concepts span heat wave, extreme heat, heat stroke, heat illness. Matches are typed broader-narrower/related-component so claims inherit the right caveats.
